mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN user_id1 = #{user_id} THEN user_id2 WHEN user_id2 = #{user_id} THEN user_id1 END AS user_id, nickname, room_id, (SELECT message FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_id=c.room_id ORDER BY create_at DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) as message FROM chat_room c JOIN users u ON u.id = CASE WHEN c.user_id1 = #{user_id} THEN c.user_id2 WHEN c.user_id2 = #{user_id} THEN c.user_id1 END WHERE user_id1 = #{user_id} OR user_id2 = #{user_id}
